approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox executable into native x64 code, built from the player's own copy at first start; fork of Far Cry Instincts Recomp, Direct3D 11
notes: All story levels play from the menus. 30 to 120 frames/s with frame-rate corrections for the game logic, widescreen (Hor+), field of view, direct mouse look, split screen for 2 to 4 players, settings menu, save protection, Steam Deck and ROG Ally X defaults. No game code or data is shipped.
